decisions: Minutes of the February 14, 2025 board meeting approved as amended.
Reallocation of $120,000 from the discretionary marketing budget approved to offset Q1 2025 staffing overruns; full Q1 financial close report to be presented at the next meeting.

Expansion of the Northwind Partners contract approved; a formal proposal for a new data analytics workstream (est. $380,000 p.a., minimum 32% margin) to be delivered to the client by April 11, 2025, with an amended contract targeted before June 30, 2025.
Phase II of the Operational Efficiency Initiative approved with a $210,000 budget and a May 1, 2025 launch date; internal staff briefing required by April 18, 2025.
Three-part talent retention strategy approved, including a career progression framework (due May 16, 2025) and a performance bonus pool of up to $185,000 for FY2025.
Next board meeting confirmed for April 25, 2025; attendance at the National Consulting Leaders Summit (April 28–29, 2025, Chicago) encouraged for all leadership members.
